item.title: Generative AI and Data Envelopment Analysis for Performance Measurement and Public Value
item.content:encoded:
This special issue explores the intersection of generative artificial intelligence and data envelopment analysis as tools for measuring organizational performance and creating public value. The collection seeks research that demonstrates how these technologies can enhance performance evaluation methodologies and provide insights into efficiency across various sectors, particularly in public organizations where value creation extends beyond traditional financial metrics.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Applications of generative AI in performance measurement
  • Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) methodologies
  • Public value creation and assessment
  • Integration of AI and DEA techniques
  • Performance evaluation in public sector organizations
  • Efficiency measurement using advanced analytics

Timeline

  • September 1, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Is Progress Possible Without People? Navigating Quality of Life Between Homo Sapiens and Homo Digitalis
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines the fundamental tension between technological progress and human welfare. It investigates whether societal advancement driven by digitalization and automation can meaningfully improve quality of life, or whether such progress may come at the expense of fundamental human values and well-being. The collection seeks scholarly work exploring the balance between homo sapiens and homo digitalis.

The issue targets researchers and practitioners interested in understanding how digitalization reshapes quality of life across social, economic, and personal dimensions. It welcomes diverse perspectives on measuring progress, evaluating technological impact on human flourishing, and envisioning sustainable development that prioritizes both innovation and human dignity.

Appel publié par Socio-Economic Planning Sciences. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Quality of life in the context of technological advancement
  • The relationship between human welfare and digital transformation
  • Progress and human values
  • Socio-economic impacts of digitalization
  • Definitions and measurement of quality of life in the digital age

Timeline

  • September 30, 2026: Submission deadline

item.title: Multi-Criteria Decision Analysis (MCDA) for Tariffs and Supply Chains: Pathways to Resilient Economic Planning
item.content:encoded:
This special issue focuses on the application of multi-criteria decision analysis methods to address complex economic planning challenges related to tariffs and supply chain management. The collection seeks to explore how MCDA approaches can inform policy decisions and strategies for building more resilient economic systems in the face of global trade complexities and supply chain disruptions.

item.title: Operations Research and Data-Driven Decision Making for Complex Socio-Economic Systems in Ibero-America: Evidence and Applications
item.content:encoded:
This special issue seeks research that applies operations research and data-driven methodologies to address complex socio-economic challenges within Ibero-American countries. The focus is on demonstrating how quantitative and analytical approaches can inform policy decisions and solve real-world problems affecting social and economic systems in this region.
